title: Report ordinary remote bridge disconnection and omit unused remote stale statuses accurately
outcome: Remote transport status metadata reflects a previously live bridge awaiting a fresh full cut after ordinary disconnect, preserves terminal output-limit status, and avoids misleading stale entries for unused remotes.
acceptance: A current live remote bridge that disconnects ordinarily is reported pending/stale until a new authoritative full cut is applied, with terminal output-limit state preserved.
Enabled remotes with neither a desired bridge nor a connection do not claim displayed stale data, or the documented contract is narrowed consistently.
Behavioural coverage observes disconnect, status publication and full-cut recovery.
